btn_curator.text: In 1927 Ralph Peer put an advert in the paper and musicians came down out of the hills to record. The Carter Family drove in from Maces Spring, Virginia. Jimmie Rodgers came up from Asheville. Records made here sold all over America.
Johnny Cash, who married into the Carter Family, called the Bristol Sessions the most important event in the history of country music. He may have been a little biased.
